text:
Ellie (FinOps): Heads up — our March invoice has a set of weird lines called `AcceleratorCommitmentAdjustment` that look like credits and then immediate charges across three zones. total delta ~+$12k. anyone else seeing this? :eyes:
Ryan (Infra): I saw a flagged row earlier, didn't dig in. Which zones? us-west1/us-central1/ap-south1?
Ellie (FinOps): exact lines (snippet):
```
2026-03-01 | AcceleratorCommitmentAdjustment | us-west1 | -$18,432.00
2026-03-01 | AcceleratorCommitmentAdjustment | us-central1 | +$6,000.00
2026-03-01 | AcceleratorCommitmentAdjustment | ap-south1 | +$24,500.00
```
Ellie (FinOps): net +$12,068 on that group. billing export shows commitments used but credits not applied consistently.
Kai Ops: We moved some reserved commitments during a capacity rebalance last week (migrated reserved capacity from us-west1 -> ap-south1). Could be a mapping glitch. I can pull migration job IDs.
Mira (SRE): tagging infra: did any of the migration ops touch commitment IDs or change invoice-region mapping? We only moved instances, not commitments AFAIK.
Ryan (Infra): Quick timeline: 2026-02-25 to 2026-02-28 we executed reserve-reassign job #rr-733. That touched commitments CMT-9982 and CMT-9983. I have the job logs.
Ellie (FinOps): Can you paste the commit IDs and timestamps? Cloud billing needs exact commitment ids for dispute.
Ryan (Infra): CMT-9982 -> reassigned to ap-south1 on 2026-02-26T03:14Z, CMT-9983 -> disabled 2026-02-27T21:40Z. Job output: `reassign_success: true`
Ellie (FinOps): OK. I've opened a case with provider (ref INC-7841). CloudSupportBot: your case INC-7841 has been created. Please provide invoice lines and commitment IDs.
CloudSupportBot: Case INC-7841 updated: initial triage suggests a post-migration ledger reconciliation issue where credits were applied to the old regional ledger before the reassign completed. Escalating to billing-engine team.
Ellie (FinOps): Good. Two asks for infra: 1) export of reservation assignment history CSV for CMT-9982/9983 (timestamps + zone mapping); 2) exact resource ids attached during window 2026-02-25..2026-03-02.
Ryan (Infra): On it, will drop CSV in #eng-infra and link here when ready. ETA 30m.
Kai Ops: Also check if any overlapping commitments existed for same sku in different regions — double application could cause the + charges.
Ellie (FinOps): If cloud confirms internal ledger bug we'll dispute the invoice but need docs to hold the charge. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Ryan (Infra): CSV uploaded: https://redwood.internal/downloads/rr-733-commitment-history.csv — contains reassign timestamps and resource attachments.
Ellie (FinOps): grabbing it now, will attach to INC-7841. I'll post back when support responds.
CloudSupportBot: INC-7841 status: billing-engine investigating. Preliminary estimate: possible double-billing window 2026-02-26T02:45Z..2026-02-27T22:00Z.
Mira (SRE): Noting for cost-alerts: if they reverse charges we'll need to reconcile internal cost reports. Flagging a follow-up to FinOps-runbook.
Ellie (FinOps): Added a follow-up checklist item: reconcile charges + adjust internal cost allocation if credit applied.
Ellie (FinOps): final note: if anyone sees similar `AcceleratorCommitmentAdjustment` spikes in other accounts, DM me.
